title: Grateful Dead Live at Action House on 1970-11-10

ai_review.summary: A mis‑dated compilation with an unlistenable Not Fade Away and a decent Other One, offering poor overall recording quality.
ai_review.review: The tape is a mash‑up of two unrelated excerpts – Not Fade Away from 9/20/70 (recorded badly enough to be virtually unlistenable) and The Other One from 2/23/71 (which reviewers describe as solid).  In addition, the file is falsely dated, so it doesn’t represent a single concert performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Four reviews give very low scores (average ~1.8) and repeatedly criticize the recording quality and fake date, with only a modest positive note about The Other One.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not Fade Away segment is described as unlistenable; The Other One segment sounds acceptable. The tape appears to be a compiled reel from Marty Weinberg, not a proper soundboard or audience recording of one show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The tracks are taken from different dates and stitched together, so there is no coherent set structure; it functions more as a filler compilation than a true concert.
